ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this ("Agreement”", made as of the27day of Okud, 2012, by and between 2191 Third Avenue, LLC ("Owner"), a New York limited liability company,having an address at 2191 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10035 and East 119" Street Development LLC (*Developer"), a New York limited liability company having an address at 117-18 Queens Blvd., Forest Hills, New York 11375 WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, if any, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known as Lot 4 in Block 1784 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,and as and by the street address 2191 Third Avenue,NewYork,NewYork 10035,and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"), the building located thereon isreferred toasthe“OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, if any, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 2 in Block 1784 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and as and by the street address 2191 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10035,and more particularly described in Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"), the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the (*Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS,the OwnerParcel and the DeveloperParcel(as hereinafter defined) are being merged into a'single zoning lot under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the Existing Developer Building and construct anewbuilding,all or aportionof whichwillbe on theDeveloper Land,and to construct other improvements associated with such new building,including,at Developer's option,to cantilever aportion of the new building over the existing improvements on the Owner Parcel (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building";and the Developer Land and the Existing Developer Building or the Developer Building or the Developer Building are herein collectively referred toasthe("DeveloperParcel"); WHEREAS, the. Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resoluition, than is now available for use on the OwnerParcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the:Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined);

WHEREAS,it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the ZoningResolution for theMerged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as tomake available the Conveyed Excess Development Rights (ashereinafter defined)forutilizationinconnectionwith theconstructionandmaintenanceof the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Conveyed Excess Development Rights availabletoDeveloperinperpetuity; WHEREAS, the parties are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a singlezoninglotof the OwnerParcel and theDeveloperParcel(such zoninglot,as the same may be enlargedinaccordancewiththeDeclarationandthetermsofthisAgreement,ishereinreferredto as the ("Merged Zoning Lot"),attached hereto as Exhibit D and (ii) such other agreements,easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intend of the parties in connection with the Conveyed Excess Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements and licenses are herein hereto as Exhibit F; WHEREAS, all parties in interest (as defined in the Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution)to the OwnerParcel andtheDeveloperParcelasshownon theZoningLot Certification of Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company, annexed hereto as Exhibit C, have executed the Declaration or waived their right to execute the Declaration and have subordinated their interest in the Owner Parcel, as the case may be, to the Declaration and to this Agreement to the extent set forth in the waivers and subordinations attached hereto inExhibit E; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged,the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. (b)“Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting or adding thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoninglotby the base maximum allowablefloor area ratio established for the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located,(i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and (i) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time. 2
